Use case: stylized-concept. Production native-transparent combat animation sprite sheet. The supplied reference montage: LEFT large portrait = approved IDENTITY/materials/palette ONLY; TOP RIGHT frog/troll/slime = USER APPROVED 0098 C CAMERA, reproduce this camera; BOTTOM RIGHT four actual map assets = SAME elevated game-map camera. Old tiny character at bottom LEFT = accessory information only, NOT camera.
CAMERA from 0098 candidate C: orthographic 2:1 dimetric, look DOWN at 42 degrees above horizontal, whole body facing SCREEN LOWER LEFT / SOUTHWEST, 3/4 FRONT. This is a camera reconstruction, not merely rotating a frontal portrait. Top surfaces of crown/helmet/head plus shoulders/back must occupy AT LEAST as much projected area as front/face/chest. Crown broad, face small and low, look down-left, forehead visible, chin tiny, far eye compressed. Foreshorten torso and lower body. Near and far feet stagger diagonally in depth. Preserve exact camera through ALL poses, no looking up to expose whole portrait face.
LAYOUT: EXACTLY FOUR columns and FIVE rows, tall 1024x1280 canvas, 20 separated complete poses of the SAME species. ALL 20 face SCREEN LOWER LEFT / SOUTHWEST 3/4 FRONT with pronounced diagonal leftward head and torso, far eye mostly hidden. Keep direction through recovery too.
ROW1 idle relaxed, idle breathing, defeated kneeling/slumped, defeated resting on ground. ROW2 four consecutive moving/walking poses. ROW3 four attack poses windup, strike in facing direction, contact, recover. ROW4 four skill poses gather, prepare, strongest expression, settle. ROW5 four hit reactions startle, recoil, compress, recover. Exactly 20 entire sprites; large genuinely transparent gutters; all parts fully inside equal cells. Same scale across cells, feet centered x50% y85%, no clipping. Single generated horizontal translucent 2:1 contact ellipse underneath. No floating particles. Native alpha TRANSPARENT background, NO white, NO checkerboard, NO words/grid/lines/scenery.
CAMERA IS THE PRIORITY: see approved frog C on reference. Look ONTO head/crown from above; broad TOP of head and upper BACK cover the upper TWO THIRDS of creature, face is a small compressed sliver near LOWER LEFT edge for SW, no symmetrical portrait face. Helmet/head center recedes toward upper right behind face. Near and far feet on diagonal, short torso and legs, overhead tabletop miniature view matching bed mattress and frog hat. Do not copy portrait camera. All frames same camera, attack and recoil never tilt face up. Soft painterly rendering/colors/materials identical to approved portrait.
IDENTITY: EXACTLY THREE small grey rats as ONE compact group in EACH of 40 cells, never two/four rats. Red headbands, pink ears/noses/feet/tails, little brown harness belts/pouches and brass bells, one small yellow triangular cheese pennant on wooden stick held by rear rat, front leader clenched paws. No text on pennant. Each rat faces SW in left half, NE with backs in right half. Overhead broad heads/backs, small low faces, short bodies. Preserve three visible individuals and flag in every cell, no extra cheese.
STRICT SOUTHWEST AZIMUTH: rotate whole head and torso 50 degrees towards SCREEN LEFT. Nose sticks toward LEFT EDGE, NOT toward viewer. One eye on far side compressed to half-width or hidden. One shoulder behind the other. Hat/head top plus back MUST exceed visible face/chest area.
